questions.question: What should you do if you encounter an aggressive driver?
questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of their way.
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of an aggressive driver's way. Do not try to compete with them. Always follow traffic rules to stay safe and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a road with many curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: For any reason.
questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign is a mandatory rule. It means you cannot pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that one lane is ending. Move to the left lane soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to upcoming curves in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for bicycles. They may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Wait for a green light before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, look both ways, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Side road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is coming ahead.

questions.question: A blood alcohol concentration of 0.02 percent:

options.text: Won't put other drivers at risk.
Will double your chances of having an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will double your chances of having an accident.
questions.explanation: Each 0.02 percent increase in blood alcohol nearly doubles your risk of a fatal crash.

questions.question: A solid yellow arrow on a traffic signal means:

options.text: Speed up to make the turn before the light changes.
You don't need to signal when turning from this lane.
Get ready to stop and yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready to stop and yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the green arrow is ending. You should prepare to stop and yield to oncoming traffic before turning.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Use your left foot to brake.
Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
Always brake hard to ensure you stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
questions.explanation: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating. Apply the brakes gently with steady pressure so your vehicle stops smoothly.

questions.question: Fatigue increases the risk of:

options.text: Falling asleep behind the wheel and crashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Falling asleep behind the wheel and crashing.
questions.explanation: Fatigue makes you slower to react and decide. You could fall asleep behind the wheel and crash, hurting or killing yourself or others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: To help avoid skidding on slippery surfaces, you should:

options.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up to enter curves and slow down to exit them.
Slow down before entering curves and intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering curves and intersections.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve because you can't see what's ahead. Braking on a curve may cause you to skid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light at an intersection means:

options.text: The same as a yield sign.
The light is about to turn green.
The same as a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and proceed when safe. This is the same as a stop sign.

questions.question: You are driving on the freeway behind a large truck. How should you drive?

options.text: Drive close behind the truck in bad weather because the driver can see farther ahead.
Drive farther behind the truck than you would behind a regular car.
Stay no more than one car length behind the truck so the driver can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive farther behind the truck than you would behind a regular car.
questions.explanation: If you drive too close behind a truck, the truck driver cannot see you in the side mirrors. Tailgating is dangerous because you lose your safety cushion if the truck stops quickly.

questions.question: You see flooded water on the road ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Do not drive through the flooded area. Turn around and find another route.
Drive only in the center of the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive through the flooded area. Turn around and find another route.
questions.explanation: Never drive on a flooded road. Water can hide hazards you cannot see. If you see a flooded area, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: On a slippery road, your following distance should be:

options.text: Farther from the car ahead than normal.
Closer to the car ahead than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farther from the car ahead than normal.
questions.explanation: Your car needs more distance to stop on a slippery road than on a dry road. Always increase your following distance on slippery roads.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Use cruise control near a railroad crossing to keep a steady speed.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
You have the right-of-way at a railroad crossing and do not need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
questions.explanation: Always stop at a railroad crossing when directed by a flagger, stop sign, or warning signal. Drive carefully near railroad tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means a school zone or school crossing is near. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: When may you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a road with a solid line next to your lane.
On a road with a broken line next to your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a road with a broken line next to your lane.
questions.explanation: A broken line means you can cross it to change lanes. When a dashed yellow line is next to your lane, you may pass. Only change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.
